sentences.en: And Malinche, we're told, says, I mean, she's all in with the Spaniards by now.
sentences.zh: 据说马林切这时开口了，她现在已经完全倒向了西班牙人这边。

sentences.en: Because triumph for her.
sentences.zh: 因为这对她来说是胜利。

sentences.en: Triumph for her, exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错，对她来说是胜利。

sentences.en: She says, you must bring us 200 bars of gold.
sentences.zh: 她说，你们必须给我们带来200块金条。

sentences.en: And she gestures with her hands to show how much she wants.
sentences.zh: 她还用手比划着，示意她想要多少。

sentences.en: And the advisor says rather weakly, well, perhaps the common people took it.
sentences.zh: 那位顾问有些虚弱地说，或许是被平民拿走了。

sentences.en: Perhaps they took it from the lake.
sentences.zh: 或许他们从湖里捞走了。

sentences.en: So that evening, Cortés organizes a victory feast for his men.
sentences.zh: 于是那天晚上，科尔特斯为他的手下举办了一场庆功宴。

sentences.en: And he organizes it not in the city, but in the lake town of Coyoacan, which is on the south side of the lake.
sentences.zh: 他举办宴会的地点不在城里，而是在湖边的科约阿坎，就在湖的南岸。

sentences.en: And is today a suburb of Mexico City.
sentences.zh: 如今那里是墨西哥城的一个郊区。

sentences.en: It's where you can see the Frida Kahlo Museum, among other things.
sentences.zh: 那里有弗里达·卡罗博物馆，还有其他许多景点。

sentences.en: It's where you see Cortés' headquarters that he then built, his palace, is still there.
sentences.zh: 科尔特斯后来建造的总部，也就是他的宫殿，至今仍在那里。

sentences.en: It's an amazing place to walk around.
sentences.zh: 那是个非常适合漫步的好地方。

sentences.en: Cortés, he has wine that's been brought from Spain.
sentences.zh: 科尔特斯带来了从西班牙运来的葡萄酒。

sentences.en: There's lots of food and drink.
sentences.zh: 有大量的食物和酒水。

sentences.en: The story is that most of his men get absolutely wasted and they're dancing on the tables.
sentences.zh: 据说他手下大部分人都喝得酩酊大醉，在桌子上跳舞。

sentences.en: They're so drunk when they leave, they're falling over in the streets and stuff.
sentences.zh: 他们离开时醉得东倒西歪，在街上摔得七荤八素。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, of course, in the city, a scene of total despair.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，城里自然是一片绝望的景象。

sentences.en: And the next morning, they basically empty the city.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，他们基本上把城里的人都清空了。

sentences.en: So the refugees start coming along the causeway, hundreds and thousands of people.
sentences.zh: 于是难民们开始沿着堤道涌出，成百上千人。

sentences.en: They haven't eaten properly for weeks.
sentences.zh: 他们已经好几周没吃过一顿饱饭了。

sentences.en: They are utterly distraught.
sentences.zh: 他们彻底崩溃了。

sentences.en: They're suffering the most appalling psychological trauma that can possibly be imagined.
sentences.zh: 他们正遭受着难以想象的、极其严重的心理创伤。

sentences.en: It's like a scene from the end of the Second World War or something.
sentences.zh: 就像二战末期的场景一样。

sentences.en: And they go across the causeway and halfway across, the Spanish soldiers are waiting.
sentences.zh: 他们穿过堤道，走到一半时，西班牙士兵正在那里等着。

sentences.en: They separate them out.
sentences.zh: 他们把人群分开。

sentences.en: Again, a very Second World War scene, it has to be said.
sentences.zh: 不得不说，这又是一个非常二战式的场景。

sentences.en: They take away the young women who will become their slaves.
sentences.zh: 他们带走了年轻女性，让她们成为奴隶。

sentences.en: Obviously, often they're sexual slaves.
sentences.zh: 显然，她们往往沦为性奴隶。

sentences.en: And then the young men, they brand them on their faces, often with the G, guerra, war.
sentences.zh: 然后是年轻男子，他们在这些人的脸上烙上印记，通常是一个“G”，代表“guerra”，即战争。

sentences.en: They're declared rebels against the King of Spain.
sentences.zh: 他们被宣布为反抗西班牙国王的叛军。

sentences.en: Because, of course, this is the fiction that the whole thing is based on.
sentences.zh: 因为当然了，这一切都是建立在虚构的基础上的。

sentences.en: That it's a rebellion.
sentences.zh: 说这是一场叛乱。

sentences.en: That it's a rebellion.
sentences.zh: 说这是一场叛乱。

sentences.en: A lot of war of conquest, yeah.
sentences.zh: 其实就是一场征服战争，没错。

sentences.en: And we are told they searched everybody for gold, and they searched in every part of your body.
sentences.zh: 据说他们搜查了每个人的黄金，甚至搜遍了身体的每一个部位。

sentences.en: So these are very intrusive body searches.
sentences.zh: 所以这些搜身极具侵犯性。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Very aggressive, intrusive searches.
sentences.zh: 非常粗暴、具有侵犯性的搜查。

sentences.en: They are looking in people's mouths and their ears, everywhere, for gold.
sentences.zh: 他们翻遍人们的嘴巴和耳朵，搜寻着黄金。

sentences.en: And then the refugees get across, those that haven't been taken away as slaves.
sentences.zh: 随后，那些没被抓去当奴隶的难民走到了对面。

sentences.en: And, of course, when they get to the other side...
sentences.zh: 当然，当他们到达彼岸时……

sentences.en: There's nothing.
sentences.zh: 什么都没有。

sentences.en: Yeah, there's nothing.
sentences.zh: 是的，什么都没有。

sentences.en: They have loSt...
sentences.zh: 他们失去了一切……

sentences.en: Yeah, it's a hellscape.
sentences.zh: 没错，那简直是人间地狱。

sentences.en: Absolutely everything.
sentences.zh: 失去了一切。

sentences.en: And we'll do one more episode to talk about the consequences for Cortez, for Mexico, for the Aztecs,
sentences.zh: 我们还会再做一期节目，谈谈这对科尔特斯、对墨西哥、对阿兹特克人的影响，

sentences.en: and to reflect on this as an episode in the history of the meat of the old and new worlds and the story of European colonization.
sentences.zh: 并反思这段旧世界与新世界碰撞的历史，以及欧洲殖民的故事。

sentences.zh: 不过汤姆，我知道你喜欢诗。

sentences.en: Perhaps you should end with this lovely poem.
sentences.zh: 也许你应该用这首优美的诗来结尾。

sentences.zh: 其实是一首非常动人的诗。

sentences.zh: 它最初是用纳瓦特尔语写的，后来被翻译了出来。

sentences.en: Our cries of sorrow rise up, and our tears pour down.
sentences.zh: 我们的悲伤呼喊升起，我们的泪水倾泻而下。

sentences.en: Nothing but flowers and songs of sorrow.
sentences.zh: 只剩下鲜花和悲伤的歌谣。

sentences.en: I left in Mexico and Tlatelolco, where once we saw warriors and wise men.
sentences.zh: 我离开了墨西哥和特拉特洛尔科，那里曾是我们目睹勇士与智者的地方。

sentences.en: We have been crushed to the ground.
sentences.zh: 我们已被碾碎在地。

sentences.en: We are lying in ruins.
sentences.zh: 我们躺在废墟之中。

sentences.en: Nothing but grief and suffering.
sentences.zh: 只剩下悲痛与苦难。

sentences.en: I left in Mexico and Tlatelolco, where once we saw beauty and courage.
sentences.zh: 我离开了墨西哥和特拉特洛尔科，那里曾是我们目睹美丽与勇气的地方。
